name: ScummVM Buildbot
author: cpasjuste & rsn8887 & ScummVM Team
description:
This download is updated every night, at midnight, PDT, to the latest buildbot release.
ScummVM is a program which allows you to run certain classic graphical point-and-click adventure games, provided you already have their data files.
ScummVM supports many adventure games, including LucasArts SCUMM games (such as Monkey Island 1-3, Day of the Tentacle, Sam & Max, ...), many of Sierra's AGI and SCI games (such as King's Quest 1-6, Space Quest 1-5, ...), Discworld 1 and 2, Simon the Sorcerer 1 and 2, Beneath A Steel Sky, Lure of the Temptress, Broken Sword 1 and 2, Flight of the Amazon Queen, Gobliiins 1-3, The Legend of Kyrandia 1-3, many of Humongous Entertainment's children's SCUMM games (including Freddi Fish and Putt Putt games) and many more.
